title: The recon dog jumps on Space and does its tricks on R, P and J: RECKON K9's own clips, kept over K0-TECH
context: The owner, 2026-11-13: "the dog is alright, but it has no jump animation. Ko-Tech has a jump animation, or Cheetah. Either we add a jump with space bar, and the roll, hand, etc. animations to the dog, or we re-place it with KoTech or Cheetah which has those." The clip lists read from the GLBs: RECKON K9 (reckon_k9_d0_lod1.glb, 1.63 MB) has Alert_Idle, Walk/Run/Pace/Canter/Gallop/Sprint cycles, Sit_Down 2.4 s, Roll_Over 4.8 s, Fetch_Return 8.0 s, Give_Paw 4.0 s and Jump 2.0 s; K0-TECH (k0_tech_d0_lod1.glb, 1.85 MB) has Watch_Idle, Feline_Walk_Cycle, Stalk_Cycle, Gallop_Cycle, Sit_Down, Pounce 3.2 s, Roll_Over 5.6 s, Give_Paw 4.4 s and no jump. The cheetah is already shipped: C-07 Mechanical Cheetah (assets/models/c07, from SentryTowers_A6 assets/mechanical-cheetah/, 1.54 MB) has the same clip set as K0-TECH, Pounce (1.2 m of root travel) and no jump; ~/Dev/SentryTowers_A6 is not on this machine. The K9 had a jump all along; the seat never played it.
outcome: Kept the K9. Space jumps: the K9's Jump clip at rate 1.4 and the drawn body lifted on an arc 4u(1-u) x 1.1 m between the clip's take-off (0.55 s) and landing (1.15 s), read off the clip's BODY bone (crouch to 0.39 by 0.4 s, peak 0.84 at 0.85 s); the run-up's speed and heading are held through the air and the walls still stop it (the same moveBy), the survey rings count as before. R rolls over, P gives a paw, J sits (held until W or S); a trick stops the dog, W or S cuts it. A knock cancels a jump or a trick, the knock rule itself unchanged. The seat's own capture-phase key listener takes Space, R, P, J while it is live (Space would fire a shell otherwise); the phone's FIRE pad jumps in the seat. The seat's hint line and the controls page teach the keys. Pure rules: src/domain/dog-scout.js jump, stepJump, trick, stepTrick; knobs DOG_SCOUT.jump, DOG_SCOUT.tricks; the companions' driven pose takes lift and rate. src/td-tab.js unchanged.
alternatives: Swap the opening's dog to K0-TECH: rejected, K0-TECH has no jump clip (Pounce is the nearest) and the K9 has one.
Swap to the cheetah (C-07): rejected for the same reason, Pounce and no jump.
A procedural hop alone: rejected, the K9's own clip reads better with the arc timed to it.
Let an airborne dog clear the bodies (no knock in the air): not done, the knock rule kept as it was; the owner's call.
evidence: GLB animation names and durations read from the glTF JSON chunk (scratch .superpowers/scratch/clips.mjs); the Jump clip's BODY bone y track sampled (jump.mjs).

test/dog-scout.mjs: the arc peaks at 1.10 m at the clip's top, off and down within 0.03 s of upS/rate and downS/rate, the dog's own again at endS/rate; no jump idle, knocked, mid-air or mid-trick; tricks end on their seconds, W/S cut, a held sit waits, a knock cancels both; keys unique and off the base's keys.
npm test (350 programs), npm run check and npm run architecture green at 72b311d0; td-tab 5,362 lines, unchanged.

--dog-scout (source, at 72b311d0) passed end to end: a real Space in the seat: jumps 1, landed 1, liftMax 1.097 m (knob 1.1), the Jump clip seen, mode driving after; a real R: trick roll, clip Roll_Over; then the two surveys, the contact, home, the wall, the Rotor's seat 67.3 s of story clock after the deploy, the first harvest (1 trip, 403 kg), THE FIRST ORDERS at 133.47 s, sector 0; no cut from the touchdown to the seat. The jump not watched by eye (headless).
